description: Remove the non-existent SlashCommand tool from the subagent-orchestrator frontmatter so the tools: list reflects real --agent runtime usage.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: The built-in tools reference lists every grantable tool name and contains zero SlashCommand entries. Confirms SlashCommand is not a callable tool (slash commands are an interactive message-parsing construct), so it cannot be granted under --agent and must be dropped from the orchestrator tools: list rather than wired.

userStories.title: Drop SlashCommand from the orchestrator tools list and reconcile the mirror + embed
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the subagent-orchestrator frontmatter tools: list to advertise only tools that the --agent runtime actually grants, so the orchestrator persona stops declaring SlashCommand (which returns 'No such tool available' under --agent) and the frontmatter matches CAM-240's runtime-binding principle.
acceptanceCriteria: SlashCommand is removed from the tools: list in .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md. [oracle: file-assert: grep -c 'SlashCommand' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md returns lower count and the tools block no longer contains a '- SlashCommand' line: ! grep -qE '^\s*-\s*SlashCommand' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

The templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md mirror is reconciled identically (the two copies are currently byte-identical; keep them so). [oracle: named-command: diff .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

The prose that still tells the orchestrator to 'use the SlashCommand tool when available' (around line 267, 'Inject commands: review, issue') is reconciled so the doc does not advertise the removed capability; the sanctioned CLI thin-proxy send-keys inject path remains described. [oracle: file-assert: ! grep -q 'SlashCommand' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]
Vendor drift check passes since templates/ changed (bun run embed-vendor was re-run to regenerate src/templates/embedded.ts). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
No other tool remaining in the orchestrator tools: list is unavailable at runtime under --agent; the list reflects only real runtime-granted tools per CAM-240. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (line 12 tools: list entry '- SlashCommand'; line ~267 prose under '### Inject commands: review, issue' referencing the SlashCommand tool) and its byte-identical mirror templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md. Both must change identically. templates/ is embedded (scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts), so run `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/templates/embedded.ts, then `bun run embed-vendor:check` must be green. Gotchas: SlashCommand is NOT a real tool: do NOT attempt to wire it (issue recommendation (b) is infeasible; the fetched tools.md confirms no such tool). .claude/agents vs templates/ dual-copy is per-file, not assumed identical (CAM-123 lesson): here they ARE currently identical: verify with diff before and after. Do NOT touch the composer-no-submit inject breakage (CAM-200) or the Skill-tool programmatic-dispatch alternative: both out of scope. This is a no-behavior-change accuracy fix closing the miss from CAM-240 US-001.
